invention.ref: Wang Mang’s ceremonial carriage umbrella described as collapsible (21 CE)
invention.ref_zh: 王莽时期（公元21年）仪仗车盖记载可张合的伞盖

popularization.ref: Modern steel-rib compact folding umbrellas spread worldwide in the 20th century
popularization.ref_zh: 二十世纪钢骨袖珍折叠伞在全球普及

locations.place_label_zh: 中国陕西西安一带（新莽宫廷语境）
locations.place_label_en: Xi’an region, Shaanxi, China (Xin-dynasty court context)

sources.title: Delving into the history of fans and umbrellas — China Culture

notes: 固定伞盖与油纸伞更早；本条目强调可折叠机构。考古上亦有更早关节伞的说法，书证以公元21年记载较常被引用。
notes_en: Fixed parasols and oil-paper umbrellas are older; this entry focuses on a collapsible mechanism. Earlier jointed parasols are sometimes claimed archaeologically; the often-cited textual mark is 21 CE.
summary_zh: 可张合的折叠伞机构在中国新莽时期（公元21年）已有记载；现代袖珍钢骨折叠伞则在二十世纪全球普及。
summary_en: A collapsible umbrella mechanism is described in China in 21 CE under Wang Mang. Modern compact steel-rib folding umbrellas spread worldwide in the twentieth century.
